description: Cross sections sigma(E) = S(E)/E exp(-B_G/sqrt(E)), E centre-of-mass energy in keV, S in keV b. Single source for slides/figures.py and derivations/chapters/ch02_fusion_reactions.py.

bosch_hale.source: H.-S. Bosch and G. M. Hale, Nucl. Fusion 32, 611 (1992), https://doi.org/10.1088/0029-5515/32/4/I07, Table IV; S in keV mb, Pade form S = (A1 + E(A2 + E(A3 + E(A4 + E A5)))) / (1 + E(B1 + E(B2 + E(B3 + E B4)))).

pp.source: E. G. Adelberger et al., Rev. Mod. Phys. 83, 195 (2011), https://doi.org/10.1103/RevModPhys.83.195: S(0) = 4.01e-25 MeV b, S'(0)/S(0) = 11.2 /MeV. B_G from E_G = 2 m c^2 (pi alpha)^2 with m = m_p/2.
